reason: The closure stands, but one premise is worded too strongly. Confirmed: dorado = 44b6 TRAIN embryo (CONTEXT l.1281-1288; 63/71 clips placed, 654/777 GT nodes coincide). The Data page says train and test are embryo-disjoint (08:49Z rules check, CONTEXT l.2096-2109), so dorado cannot hold a hidden-test crop. The 08:49Z check does remove the old 'policy' reason (3.4.b bans only hand labelling). OVERSTATED: 'the only same-instrument public recording is dorado'. Zebrahub also hosts two OpenSiMView (SimView-design) movies, ZMNS001 and ZMNS002 (https://zebrahub.sf.czbiohub.org/imaging; https://public.czbiohub.org/royerlab/zebrahub/imaging/multi-view/). The h_external-data lens did not examine them. Their neuroglancer JSONs give voxel z 1.97 / yx 0.485 um with two channels (mezzo, h2afva), while Kaggle/dorado is 1.625 / 0.40625 um. The ZMNS001.ome.zarr listing has pyramid levels 0-4 only, with no labels or tracks folder. So there is no known public recording at the Kaggle scale besides dorado, and there are no public labels to copy for the SimView movies. Reach is 'none known', not proven zero. Even with reach, image matching adds only context, not labels, so value is ~0. Ruling out a resampled ZMNS crop would take TB-scale downloads, new registration code and an uploaded dataset, which cannot meet R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC). Value and feasibility both give no mechanism and no change to the finals #37 + #38.
fix: Curator: change the I-209 reason to: 'closed on reach and R8, not on policy: dorado = 44b6 train embryo and test is embryo-disjoint; the other public SimView movies (Zebrahub ZMNS001/002) are at 0.485/1.97 um with two channels and have no public tracks; DaXi ZSNS are a different instrument; any search is TB-scale and new code after R8; the 08:49Z rules check does not reopen it.' Drop the words 'only same-instrument' and 'zero reach' (say 'no known reach'). Also correct the same sentence in the h_external-data lens_summary for lessons. No plan change and no user OK needed.
